verdict.rationale: Docs mention Teams Export APIs that let admins export 1:1, group, meeting, and channel messages (including recently deleted ones) for compliance purposes, which implies some ability to retrieve historical messages, but there is no explicit documentation of search filters like sender, channel, or date range within this pack. Community feedback also notes that Teams' search experience is generally poor ('Search is abysmal... messages going completely missing'), casting doubt on search quality even if export exists. Missing for 10: explicit admin search UI/API with sender/channel/date filters, eDiscovery/Purview search documentation, and independent verification that filtered search works reliably.
